PC Errata 2016 disc card of [[Rebel Guard]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 6 August 2016. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/rebelguard.gif rebelguard.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806105841/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/rebelguard.gif Internet Archive] (6 August 2016, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 4 June 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260604043355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/rebelguard.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Rebel Guard (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].
